The all-or-nothing availability check skips the last week, so a weekly booking can double-book that week.

The loop at `src/booking/commands/create_weekly_booking.rs:80` iterates over `&slots[..slots.len() - 1]`, which leaves out the final slot. If the table is already booked in the last requested week, `handle` doesn't return `SlotTaken`. It saves every booking, including a second one on the already-taken slot. For `weeks == 1` the slice is empty, so no availability check runs at all.

The tests miss this because `a_taken_week_books_nothing` (lines 161-176) takes week 1 of 3, which is a middle week. The route test takes week 0.
